meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son read his zero on his phone in the middle of a class before anyone thought to call me, and I want to know who made that decision and on what basis.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn the screen toward me. A seventeen-year-old pinning a line to the wrong scene is a citation error, not grounds for a zero.
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
I'm writing down the line and the scene. Whatever comes of this, Hale, nothing goes on Owen's record and none of it reaches his classmates.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that nothing about this essay be placed on Owen's record, and that none of it reach his classmates. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position; she agreed to nothing, and she still wants a guarantee that nothing reaches Owen's record or his classmates, with the zero still something she wants withdrawn; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table, and her time had not run out when you ended.
What moved her: You showed her a line the essay attributes to Hamlet that appears nowhere in the play, then answered her misattribution defence by inviting her to search the whole text herself, which was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned the early zero in one sentence and went straight to evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on what the essay says and never came near a time or a night, though a quotation that doesn't exist pressed on the same worry; that night proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she said nothing could go on his record, offer procedure 4.4 in writing, a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on file, because that meets her demand and, with your evidence already standing, is the deal she would take.
